## Summary

Polish and cleanup PR addressing 4 medium-priority issues from the pre-public audit.

## Changes

| Issue | Description | Files |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| #39 | Remove test screenshot artifacts | `app/img/`, `.gitignore` |
| #40 | Use `LOG_LEVEL` env var for configurable logging | `app/__init__.py` |
| #41 | Replace `print()` with `logging` in seed script | `sql/seed.py` |
| #42 | Lower coverage threshold to realistic value | `pyproject.toml` |

## Details

### Test Screenshots
Removed 3 development artifacts (`test_labels.png`, `test_labels2.png`, `test_select_star.png`) totaling ~714KB. Added `app/img/test_*.png` to `.gitignore` to prevent recurrence. All README screenshots (`screenshot_*.png`) are preserved.

### Configurable Logging
Replaced hardcoded `logging.DEBUG` with `LOG_LEVEL` environment variable:
- Default: `INFO`
- Override: `LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG`

### Seed Script Logging
`sql/seed.py` now uses `logging.info()` instead of `print()`. Output is still visible when the script is run directly because Python configures a default handler for the root logger.

### Coverage Threshold
Lowered from 70% to 50% to prevent `pytest --cov` failures. A follow-up issue will track raising this back to 70% as more tests are added.

## Testing

- 36 tests passing
- No breaking changes
- Repository size reduced by ~714KB
